measured.lineup: the asset is one of A to D in lineup.png beside models/uplant3.mdl, models/uplant2.mdl, models/uplant1.mdl
measured.lineupTest: asked 4 times, each in another order, which of the four was not made by Valve: judges picked C, A, B, D where the asset was C, A, B, D: told apart
measured.lineupWhy:
1. Its shape is a plain, perfectly regular cube with straight edges and flat faces, while the other three are organic plant forms with irregular outlines.
2. Its paint is a uniform flat grey with a faint mottled texture, with none of the leafy greens and shading the other three use.
3. It has no detail at all: no leaves, stems or blades, so it doesn't stand or grow like a plant the way A, B and D do.
